title: Price × the pair's serve-dominance leverage
primary_column_m2: s × d, d = ℓ, s = leverage ratio of m_pair − 1. MEC: "x = ℓ·(λ_AB − 1)", λ = L(m_AB)/L̄_c. MAT: "z_adj = z_mkt(1 + b·κ_pair), or z_mkt + b′·z_mkt·m_pair", κ = β_L(μ_pair)/β_L(μ_surface) − 1
controls_m2: M-set; s·η; Std
data_timing: Surface IOS spw O, D (A, B); μ from stage4_constants; iid leverage curve. Leak-proof IOS (inherited)
expected_effect: MEC: γ > 0 (price under-adjusts); bound 0.40 mLL men (0.10 if half priced), realistic 0.05–0.15 men, women ≤ 0.06. MAT: men 0.10–0.22 after damping (0.40 undamped), women ≤ 0.05; negative on z·m_pair
kill_test: MEC: men's gain < 0.05 mLL, or not above a λ-shuffle placebo, or γ's CI spans 0 (two-sided). MAT: 1-df test after I-007; CI includes 0 or wrong sign
deployment: MEC: arm (a) diff column x; arm (b) λ as context. MAT: not stated
notes: Normalisations differ: MEC divides by L̄_c, the mean of L over the cell's training matches (cell = tour × surface × indoor); MAT by L at the surface-mean dominance (tour × surface). x_MEC = a_c·x_MAT + (a_c − 1)·ℓ with a_c = L(μ_c)/L̄_c. Sidedness differs (MEC two-sided; MAT one-sided). MAT's predicted b ≈ c² depends on I-007. Cluster: I-002, I-003, I-004, I-007

title: Serve-dominance compression of the rating gap
primary_column_m2: "comp = logit P_iid(p_a, p_b) − logit P_iid(μ + g/2, μ − g/2)", g = p_a − p_b. To first order ≈ ½β′(μ)·D·g: s = D = p_a + p_b − 2μ, d = g. Secondary z × D (s = D, d = z)
controls_m2: C: the gap g composed at mean dominance; S-form: g, D·η; secondary: M-set; Std
data_timing: Surface IOS spw (cur_*, srf_*_eff_spw), leak-proof clock; or Stage 3 p_serve
expected_effect: Positive on comp, negative on z × D; +0.1 to +0.2 mLL if wholly unpriced; grass, fast indoor hard, men > women; sign of D flips on clay
kill_test: comp's CI spans 0 beyond the best OOS forecast; or the gain vanishes with z × surface dummies (then a surface slope)
notes: comp modulates the IOS gap, I-001 the price: different d. Secondary z × D is a probability-scale, linear cousin of I-001. Two possible sources for p (IOS or Stage 3, the latter behind ratings_iid)

title: Pair serve dominance and tiebreak share as context
primary_column_m2: Context s only: "m_pair = ½(logit p_AB + logit p_BA) − μ_surface" = ½(ΣO^spw − ΣD^spw); tb_share = P(set reaches 6-6 | p_AB, p_BA)
controls_m2: none of its own (acts through products; its price product is I-001)
data_timing: Surface IOS spw; leak-proof
expected_effect: Only through products; see I-001 (≤ 0.22 mLL men, damped)
kill_test: Jointly with MAT-M1; as a TabPFN arm on the 2019–2021 validation windows, < +0.1 mLL → kill
notes: m_pair is a linear combination of I-004's σ1 and σ2. Overlaps the critique's S2 "levels" arm (adopted in plan.md) only in spirit: S2's sums cover the seven profile statistics, not spw

title: Four point-structure sums as context
primary_column_m2: Context s: "σ1 = ΣO^spw, σ2 = ΣD^spw, σ3 = ΣO^ace, σ4 = ΣO^fi", centred per tour × surface on training seasons; TabPFN forms Δx·σk
controls_m2: TabPFN arm with a placebo (sums shuffled within tour × surface × season); EDA proxy: 21 IOS Δs × σ1–σ4, ridge, beyond the forecast
data_timing: Surface IOS; leak-proof
expected_effect: Unknown; at most the combined effect of MEC-01, -04, -06. Risk: TabPFN ignores context today
kill_test: TabPFN arm vs base, 2019–2021 validation windows: < 0.05 mLL or not above placebo
notes: σ3, σ4 are inside the S2 levels arm (adopted); σ1, σ2 are not (spw is not among the seven statistics). σ1, σ2 also follow from I-005's pairs

title: Serve-point offence and defence as exchanged pairs
primary_column_m2: Pairs (O^spw_A, O^spw_B), (D^spw_A, D^spw_B), exchanged at swap: carries ΔO, ΔD, ΣO, ΣD
controls_m2: TabPFN arm (not a linear-screen term)
data_timing: Surface IOS spw; leak-proof
expected_effect: ≤ 0.2 mLL (bounded by what it enables)
kill_test: TabPFN arm on 2019–2021 validation windows < +0.1 mLL over base
notes: Embeds a harness suggestion: train on both orientations (observed: the runner trains on the stored orientation only). That is a process change for every S column, not a feature

title: Best-of-five leverage the price under-transmits
primary_column_m2: "L = 1[bo5] × (u − v)", u = logit P_iid(actual format), v = logit P_iid(best of three): s = 1[bo5], d = u − v. Secondary 1[bo5] × (u − z)
controls_m2: S: d; s·η; z × 1[bo5]; ratings_iid (in model); Std
data_timing: best_of, ratings_iid; per-player serve-point probabilities (Stage 3 or the repaired ratings; cartographer). Sequential ratings, safe (to confirm)
expected_effect: Coefficient 0.1–0.4; men's Slams +0.3 to +1 mLL there, about +0.1 overall
kill_test: L spans 0 on men's Slams 2013–2021; or z × 1[bo5] alone does as well (then a slope, re-filed with MKT-02, -06)
deployment: TabPFN input and calibration slope modifier (framing item 3)
notes: On Bo5 rows u − v is close to 0.26·v (the originator's 1.26 ratio), so L is close to 1[bo5]·v. Cross-refs: withdrawn MAT-S3 (best_of × Δprofile, killed by calculation, different d); I-007 predicts 1.10–1.13 not 1.25; I-063. Subgroup (Bo5 ≈ 9.8%, critique S8)

title: Bo5 damping check (diagnostic)
primary_column_m2: No feature column: the ratio of logistic slopes of the result on ratings_iid, Bo5 against Bo3 (men, 2013–2021)
controls_m2: n/a
data_timing: Model frame; reads results (EDA round)
expected_effect: Ratio ≈ 0.88–0.90 confirms day-noise damping; ≈ 1.0 raises the leverage bounds by up to 1/c⁴ ≈ 2–4
kill_test: n/a: it decides others
notes: Gates I-001 (MAT side), I-003, I-010, I-011 and withdrawn MAT-S3. It reads 2013–2021 results, so it is a look-ledger row

title: The surface-IOS profile composed into a match log-odds
primary_column_m2: Composed quantity: MEC "x = logit P_iid(p^c_{A→B}, p^c_{B→A}; f)", MAT "z_C1 = logit P_iid(p_AB, p_BA; best of, deciding-set rule)", both with p = fi·fw + (1 − fi)·sw from the surface IOS of fi, fw, sw
controls_m2: C: the linear part (the component differences); nearest inputs ratings_iid, ios_points_short; Std
data_timing: surface_features srf_O_eff_*, srf_D_eff_* (first_in, first_won, second_won); stage4 constants; format and deciding-set rule. Leak-proof IOS (inherited); coverage 1.000
expected_effect: MEC: positive on x_res; bound ≈ 0.3 mLL, realistic 0–0.1; women relatively more. MAT: no sign a priori; bound 0.8–1.35 mLL men, 0.5–0.8 women if the price ignores composition entirely; realistically far less; men, grass, Bo5
kill_test: MEC: (1) p^c no better than additive spw IOS per serve point (< 0.02 milli); (2) x_res < 0.05 mLL. MAT: z_C1 or its residual on ratings_iid < +0.1 mLL on both tours, or sign flips 2013–17 vs 2018–21; screen only the residual if corr ≥ 0.98
notes: Residual variants differ: MEC x_res subtracts the spw-IOS composition (a new column); MAT subtracts ratings_iid (an input). In a linear screen that is a choice of control. Thresholds differ (0.05 vs 0.1). The two quote different "hidden" sizes (MEC: remainder after linear fit on 21 inputs ≈ 0.06 match log-odds; MAT: exact minus sum-free RMS 0.139 men). Contains I-014, I-015; I-010 is its noise-integrated variant; I-011 is conditional on it

title: Games route and the points-versus-games residual
primary_column_m2: "r = z_C2 − z_C1": hold IOS composed through sets and match minus the points route (I-008)
controls_m2: C: z_C1; hold differences and prod_hold; Std
data_timing: surface_features hold and serve components; leak-proof (inherited)
expected_effect: Small; positive on r if return big-point skill persists; prior ≤ 0.1 mLL
kill_test: Feature-only: split-half reliability of the per-player hold residual (50+ matches a half) < 0.3; then screen < +0.1 mLL
notes: Same mechanism as I-026 (big-point return skill) and part of I-025 (conversion luck). See withdrawn MAT-C7 (hold vs points scale)

title: Noise-integrated composition
primary_column_m2: "z_C4 = logit ∫ P_iid(μ_pair + (Δ + u)/2, μ_pair − (Δ + u)/2; format) φ(u; 0, V) du"
controls_m2: C: the noiseless composition (I-008, ratings_iid); Std
data_timing: As I-008 and I-003 plus Stage 3 constants (V from stage3_shrinkage.csv, or tuned on 2013–2018 without odds)
expected_effect: As a replacement for ratings_iid / ios_points_short, ≤ 0.1 mLL; mainly a diagnostic of the damping
kill_test: Without odds, 2013–2018: does not beat the noiseless version by ≥ +0.1 mLL → revisit the damping
notes: Its kill test is a no-odds forecast comparison that reads 2013–2018 results (a look-ledger row). Same question as I-007

title: The price on the point scale
primary_column_m2: d only: "d_pt = Δ_prof − Λ⁻¹(z_mkt; m_pair, format)", the profile gap minus the price inverted through the iid map at the pair's dominance and format
controls_m2: M-set; Δ_prof; I-008; Std
data_timing: As I-008, I-003, plus odds_logit
expected_effect: ≤ 0.05 mLL overall
kill_test: Dies with I-008; otherwise against I-008 < +0.05 mLL
notes: Originator: do not screen unless MAT-C1 passes. Uses I-003's m_pair

title: Free-point shield: aces beyond the returner's reach
primary_column_m2: "x = c_{A→B} − c_{B→A}", c = logit p^struct − logit p, p^struct = a + (1 − a)·r; or composed x′. X form: g(O^ace_A)·D^spw_B − g(O^ace_B)·D^spw_A (g = the shield's elasticity shortfall) = ½[Δg·ΣD^spw − Σg·ΔD^spw], plus curvature
controls_m2: X: ΔO^ace, ΔD^spw; ΣD^spw·η, Σg·η; prod_ace; Std
data_timing: Surface IOS ace and spw, leak-proof. Rich arm: returns-in-play IOS (field: clock and probe), ≈ 17,000 men's matches
expected_effect: Positive (big servers against strong returners); men > women; grass, fast hard; bound ≈ 0.35 mLL men, realistic 0–0.1
kill_test: (1) Serve-point level: < 0.02 milli per point, or returner elasticity does not fall with the server's ace share; (2) screen < 0.05 mLL
notes: 94% linear in the 21 IOS inputs (originator). Cluster: I-020, I-072, I-013

title: Within-player squares that complete prod_s
primary_column_m2: "sq_s = (O_A² − O_B²) − (D_A² − D_B²)", S-form ΔO_s·ΣO_s − ΔD_s·ΣD_s; or "e_s = expit(μ_s + O_A − D_B) − expit(μ_s + O_B − D_A)"
controls_m2: W: ΔO_s, ΔD_s; prod_s; S-form: ΣO_s·η, ΣD_s·η; Std
data_timing: surface_features O_eff, D_eff for ace, df, hold, first_won; leak-proof
expected_effect: Favours the stronger extreme; 0–0.3 mLL; men, grass, indoor hard
kill_test: Screen e_ace, e_df, e_hold (or sq_s): < +0.1 mLL beyond the price and the current best
notes: One hypothesis or one per statistic: not stated. sq_s and e_s are different columns (e_s also carries prod_s and higher orders). Its S-form uses I-004-type sums. Cluster I-012

title: Second-serve exposure × the returner's second-serve specialisation
primary_column_m2: "x = [(f̄i − π^fi_{B→A})·c_A − (f̄i − π^fi_{A→B})·c_B] / (p̄(1−p̄))", c_Q = w2·D^sw_Q − w1·D^fw_Q. With exposure E_P = f̄i − π^fi_{P→Q}: x ∝ E_B·c_A − E_A·c_B = −½[ΔE·Σc − ΣE·Δc]
controls_m2: X: ΔE (ΔO^fi, ΔD^fi), Δc (ΔD^sw, ΔD^fw); ΣE·η, Σc·η; prod_first_in, prod_second_won; Std
data_timing: Surface IOS fi, fw, sw; leak-proof
expected_effect: Positive; women > men; ≤ 0.1 mLL
kill_test: Serve-point level: slope of the matchup's serve-point residual on (f̄i − π^fi)·c_returner, CI includes 0 → kill; then the screen
notes: Originator: "MEC-05 contains it" (inside I-008). Same mechanism as I-015, different formula (a specialisation contrast, first order)

title: Second-serve exposure against second-serve return
primary_column_m2: "E_2 = (1 − fi_AB)(1 − sw_AB) − (1 − fi_BA)(1 − sw_BA)": f(O_A, D_B) − f(O_B, D_A) with f a product of two expit terms (fi and sw)
controls_m2: X: ΔO^fi, ΔD^fi, ΔO^sw, ΔD^sw; their sums × η; prod_first_in, prod_second_won; Std
data_timing: surface_features first_in, second_won; leak-proof
expected_effect: Small part of I-008 (its whole non-linearity is RMS 0.0043, 7%)
kill_test: Dies with I-008
notes: Listed so an interpretable form exists if I-008 passes. Cluster I-014, I-016

title: Risky second servers against second-serve attackers
primary_column_m2: "x = ρ_A·D^sw_B − ρ_B·D^sw_A", ρ = z(O^df) + z(O^sw) = ½[Δρ·ΣD^sw − Σρ·ΔD^sw]
controls_m2: X: Δρ (ΔO^df, ΔO^sw), ΔD^sw; Σρ·η, ΣD^sw·η; prod_df, prod_second_won; Std
data_timing: Surface IOS df, sw; leak-proof
expected_effect: Small, either sign; women more
kill_test: Statistic level: residuals of second-serve points won and double faults on ρ_server × D^sw_returner; both CIs include 0 → kill
notes: Two-sided: sign not declared

title: Total strength against style difference (structural null)
primary_column_m2: d only, linear: "ΔT_s = iosO_s + iosD_s and ΔY_s = iosO_s − iosD_s"; the test is the ΔY composite given the price and ΔT
controls_m2: ΔT; the existing iosO_s, iosD_s; Std
data_timing: Model frame in_iosO_s, in_iosD_s; leak-proof
expected_effect: Under iid and an efficient price the ΔY coefficient is 0; a non-zero sign says which style the price under-rates
kill_test: ΔY composite's CI includes 0 on both tours → no feature (recorded as structural confirmation)
notes: A rotation of existing inputs, so linear in the 58 by construction. The weights of the "ΔY composite" across statistics are not specified

title: Style-pair residual table
primary_column_m2: Categorical X: "x = τ_{s(A)s(B)} − τ_{s(B)s(A)}", τ_ij the shrunk serve-point residual of style i serving to style j; k = 6 styles by k-means on (O^spw, D^spw, O^ace, O^fi, O^df, hand)
controls_m2: X: differences of the style indicators and of the clustering inputs; Std
data_timing: IOS and box scores; field (clock and probe); centroids frozen on 2010–2016
kill_test: τ from 2010–2016 vs 2017–2021 correlates < 0.3 cell by cell, or out-of-sample serve-point gain < 0.02 milli per point
notes: Hand is a clustering input (overlap I-021)

title: Points-based head-to-head residual
primary_column_m2: d only: "r_AB = Σ_k (u^A_k − u^B_k) / (Σ_k points_k + 1,000)", serve points won beyond IOS in earlier meetings
controls_m2: W-type: IOS spw differences; Std (no earlier meeting in about 40%)
data_timing: stage0 box scores; the pair's meetings in order (safe); expectations from leak-proof IOS
expected_effect: Tiny
kill_test: Pairs with ≥ 3 meetings: corr of meetings 1..k−1 with meeting k < 0.05 → kill
notes: Cluster: I-025 arm (b) (head-to-head luck), I-091 (head-to-head narrative)

title: Lost first-serve speed × the returner
primary_column_m2: "x = s_A·D^spw_B − s_B·D^spw_A" = ½[Δs·ΣD^spw − Σs·ΔD^spw], s = shrunk change in first-serve speed
controls_m2: X: Δs, ΔD^spw; Σs·η, ΣD^spw·η; Std
data_timing: Shot-level serve speeds, ≈ 10,200 men's matches (partial); own-order (safe)
expected_effect: Men; small; coverage-limited. A drop facing a strong returner is negative for A
kill_test: Infeasible if < 30% of 2014–2021 men's main-tour matches carry speeds; else the screen at 0.05
notes: Cluster I-012 (its mechanism), I-045 (speed variant). The brief's one shot-level direction to watch (men's serve speed)

title: How each player serves to, and returns against, left-handers
primary_column_m2: "x = (E_A L_B − F_B L_A) − (E_B L_A − F_A L_B)" (× L(m) for match log-odds) = G_A·L_B − G_B·L_A with G = E + F, = ½[ΔG·ΣL − ΣG·ΔL]; L = 1 for a left-hander, E and F ridge-shrunk hand deviations of an extended IOS. Arms (b) ΔL; (c) exposure x_e = L_A(ē − e_B) − L_B(ē − e_A)
controls_m2: X: ΔG, ΔL; ΣG·η, ΣL·η; Std; M4 permutation
data_timing: stage0 hand (99.7% men, 98% women) and box scores; field: a new IOS solve on the clock, probe. Applies to 24% (men) and 15% (women) of matches
expected_effect: Only in left- vs right-hander matches; ≤ 0.1 mLL overall
kill_test: Persistence first: right-handed returners with ≥ 1,500 return points against left-handers, F_R odd/even-season corr < 0.15, or not above a shuffled-hand placebo → kill
notes: Earlier crude tests tied (lefty indicator, men) or were worse (career record against the hand, women). Withdrawn W-01 (ad-court slice) is the killed variant. Hand is also an input of I-018

title: Kick second serve against a short returner
primary_column_m2: "x = O^sw_A·(h̄ − h_B) − O^sw_B·(h̄ − h_A)" = ½[ΔO^sw·(2h̄ − Σh) + ΣO^sw·Δh]
controls_m2: X: ΔO^sw, Δh; ΣO^sw·η, Σh·η; prod_second_won; Std; M4 permutation
data_timing: stage0 height: men 99.5%; women 80% and 37% in 2022–2026, so men only. Static height, leak-proof IOS
expected_effect: Tiny; men
kill_test: Statistic level: slope of the second-serve residual on O^sw_server × (h̄ − h_returner), CI includes 0 → kill
notes: Height × height cancels (withdrawn W-05). Cluster I-023, I-024

title: Height as the serve prior for thin histories
primary_column_m2: "x = ΔÕ^ace − ΔO^ace", Õ^ace = (n·O^ace + K_h·β_h(h − h̄))/(n + K_h): W with a per-player reliability weight K_h/(n + K_h) on (height prior − current rating)
controls_m2: U: the unweighted ΔO^ace and Δh; Std; M4 permutation
data_timing: Height (men only), IOS, rated serve points n; static and leak-proof; β_h fitted up to 2018 without outcomes
expected_effect: Young men; ≤ 0.05 mLL overall
kill_test: Statistic level: for players with < 1,000 rated serve points, height must improve next-match ace and serve-point forecasts by ≥ 0.05 milli per point
notes: Height difference as a main effect tied before (−0.02, men). Uses the same evidence count as I-032

title: Height × age and height × load
primary_column_m2: Two columns, no primary declared: "[height_X·(age_X − 28)+]_A − [·]_B" and "[height_X·Fat_X]_A − [·]_B". Within-player product: x_A y_A − x_B y_B = ½[Δx·Σy + Σx·Δy]
controls_m2: W: Δheight, Δ(age − 28)+, ΔFat; Σheight·η, Σage·η, ΣFat·η; Std; M4 permutation
data_timing: stage0 height (87% men's, 65% women's evaluation matches; 37% women 2022–2026); Fat from I-052. Safe
expected_effect: Small; men; 0.02–0.1 mLL
kill_test: No gain; coverage too thin for women
notes: Depends on I-052 (Fat kernel). Cluster I-053 (age × load), I-022

title: Conversion luck: results beyond the points
primary_column_m2: d only, a new per-player quantity: arm (a) "x = Λ_A − Λ_B", Λ_P a decayed (13-week half-life), shrunk mean of e_k = y_k − σ(β_f·(t_k − ½)). Arm (b) head-to-head luck "x_h = Σ_meetings e^A_k / (n_AB + 2)"
controls_m2: W: nearest inputs (elo_games, elo_overall, adjperf_tpw_2w, points_52w); Std
data_timing: stage0_match_players points won and played, earlier results; own-order, each result from lf + 1; ≈ 99% main tour. β_f fitted on 2010–2018
expected_effect: Negative (lucky players priced too short); 0–0.15 mLL; both tours; Bo3 > Bo5
kill_test: If e carries over between split halves at r > 0.2, reframe as skill; otherwise gain < 0.05 mLL or CI spans 0 → kill
notes: Priors quoted: 52-week tiebreak record −0.02, a tie (MEC); decayed conversion luck −0.01, a tie (quoted in MKT-13). Arm (b) has no price term although labelled M / X. Cluster I-009, I-019, I-086

title: Big-point return skill × the scarcity of break points
primary_column_m2: "x = (b_A − b_B)·(β̄_c/β̂_AB)": s = β̄_c/β̂_AB (inverse expected break points per service game from the iid model, symmetric), d = Δb (importance-weighted minus plain return points won)
controls_m2: S: Δb; s·η; Std
data_timing: Point-by-point (shot_level): Slams 2011–2024 in part, tour feeds; own-order (safe); partial coverage
expected_effect: Tiny. Prior: the main effect tied (−0.05, men)
kill_test: Screen gain < 0.05, or coverage < 30% of 2014–2021 main-tour matches
notes: The modulator is a function of serve dominance (family 01). Same skill as I-009's persistent part

title: Resilience excess: breaking back and consolidating
primary_column_m2: d: "x = R_A − R_B", R = shrunk excess of breaks back and consolidations over the player's own hold and break rates. S arm: s = 4p(1 − p) from the price, d = ΔR
controls_m2: W: hold and break inputs (form_hold, form_brk); S arm: ΔR, s·η and the M-set (s is a function of the price); Std
data_timing: Point-by-point sequences (19,500 men's, 9,900 women's matches); own-order (safe)
expected_effect: Tiny
kill_test: Split-half carry-over of the excess ≤ 0.1 → kill
notes: Partial coverage (point-by-point)

title: Within-match streakiness compresses the price
primary_column_m2: s × d, d = price log-odds, s = centred sum of per-player within-match excess. MEC: "x = ℓ·(v − v̄_c)", v = V_A + V_B, V = shrunk, decayed excess dispersion of the games share across sets beyond iid at the match's own rates. MAT: "z × (K_pair − K̄)", κ̂ = excess variance of the per-set game share beyond iid at the match's own rates, shrunk
controls_m2: M-set; s·η; Std
data_timing: stage0 set scores and box scores (MAT adds point-by-point where held); own-order (safe)
expected_effect: MEC: negative (pre-declared); women > men; ≤ 0.2 mLL. MAT: below I-029; ≤ 0.1–0.2 mLL
kill_test: MEC: measure's split-half carry-over ≤ 0.1, or not above the iid replay; then the screen. MAT: split-half reliability of κ̂ < 0.3 → kill
notes: Constants differ: MEC decays and centres within the cell (tour × surface × indoor), MAT centres on K̄; "dispersion" (MEC) vs "variance" (MAT) to be fixed as one definition; reliability thresholds 0.1 vs 0.3. MAT-S5 writes "z" (read as the price). MEC-17's secondary arms stay attached: (ii) between-match excess serve-point residual variance (close to I-029's serve part) and V_A − V_B (a W difference). MEC notes the predictive-frontier variability family (+0.23, a tie, men)

title: The pair's day-to-day variance flattens the odds
primary_column_m2: "z_mkt·(V_pair/V̄ − 1)" and "Δprofile·(V_pair/V̄ − 1)": s = V_pair/V̄ − 1, V_pair = σ̂²_A + σ̂²_B (long-memory squared per-match serve and return residuals, logit, minus the binomial part, shrunk)
controls_m2: M-set (price term); s·η; Std
data_timing: Per-match residuals against pre-match ratings (Stage 3, IOS or stageB_adj); cross-player ratings, so the clock and the probe
expected_effect: Negative on z_mkt × V_pair. Bound by pair CV: 0.1 → 0.03–0.05; 0.2 → 0.12–0.20; 0.3 → 0.28–0.45; 0.5 → 0.77–1.25 mLL (0.11 at CV 0.3 if conditions take half)
kill_test: Feature-only: split-half reliability of σ̂² (50+ matches a half) < 0.3, or de-noised pair CV < 0.2 → kill; then the 1-df screen
notes: Two terms (price and profile); the declared sign is on the price term. Cluster I-028, I-030

title: Volatility compression: the price prices means, not variance
primary_column_m2: "z × V", V = σ²_A + σ²_B, σ = shrunk SD of match-level residuals of total points won against expectation over 52 weeks. Secondary Δ1 × V
controls_m2: M-set; V (originator's main effect); s·η; Std
data_timing: Per-player σ to rebuild (predictive_frontier/features.py or Stage 0); sequential expectations safe, IOS-based need the clock
expected_effect: Negative (shrink to 50%); erratic young players, WTA; +0.05 to +0.3 mLL
kill_test: Coefficient ≥ 0 or spans 0; or nothing beyond MKT-08 (then the two merge into one shrinkage term)
deployment: TabPFN input and calibration slope modifier (framing item 3)
notes: Prior: frontier reliability/variability +0.232, a tie (men, 2019+, seen on 2022+). Different statistic from I-029 (total points won, no binomial term stated), so kept separate. Originator's own merge condition points at I-034

title: Re-anchor the two-week form on each player's long-memory level
primary_column_m2: "Δform*_s = form*_A − form*_B", form* = ℓ_i + r_i(raw_i − ℓ_i), r_i = Σw_i/(Σw_i + K′). Within-player product: Δ[r·(raw − ℓ)] = ½[Δr·Σ(raw − ℓ) + Σr·Δ(raw − ℓ)]. Or (r_A, r_B) as a pair
controls_m2: U: the unweighted Δform_s (existing form_s) and Δℓ; Σ(raw − ℓ)·η, Σr·η; Std
data_timing: ufc_ideas/stageB_adj.parquet per-match z; Stage B decayed sums; 52-week and career forms. Own history; opponent norms from the leak-proof perplayer_features.parquet
expected_effect: Positive; +0.1 to +0.4 mLL, more for men
kill_test: Precheck: CV of r_i < 0.2 → kill. Then Δform* (16 columns or a composite) < +0.1 mLL, or a TabPFN arm on 2019–2021 ties → kill
deployment: 16 diff columns, a composite, or the pair (r_A, r_B)
notes: Whether Δform* replaces or joins form_s is not stated. Cluster I-070 (age-weighted short-minus-long), I-033 (its symmetric twin), I-048

title: Unknown is not average: the evidence behind each IOS value
primary_column_m2: "ΔIOS × r̄ with r̄ = 2r_A·r_B/(r_A + r_B) and r_i = n_i/(n_i + K_s)": s = r̄ (symmetric), d = ΔIOS. Or (n_A, n_B) as a pair
controls_m2: S/U: ΔIOS (unweighted); r̄·η; Std
data_timing: Surface-IOS solver's per-player information, or counts of box-score units on the surface within the IOS memory (own history, safe)
expected_effect: Positive: women (box-score holes), grass, early surface season; plausibly 0.1–0.3 mLL
kill_test: Precheck: CV of r̄ < 0.15 → kill; then the screen < +0.1 mLL
deployment: pair columns, or a weighted diff
notes: Which IOS statistics are weighted is not specified. Originator's caution: Stage 3 posterior variances are nearly uniform (withdrawn MAT-U3). r̄ is also a context in I-040. Cluster I-023, I-048

title: Flux: when short and long memory disagree
primary_column_m2: "F_pair = (form_A − ℓ_A)² + (form_B − ℓ_B)² (symmetric) × z_mkt": s = F_pair, d = z_mkt
controls_m2: M-set; F_pair·η; Std
data_timing: As I-031
expected_effect: Likely ≤ 0.1 mLL; low priority
kill_test: Feature-only: matches with implied flux variance > 0.03 logit² are < 5% → kill
notes: Statistic or composite behind "form" not specified. Symmetric twin of I-031

title: Conflict shrinkage: statistics and ratings disagree
primary_column_m2: "z × abs(Δ1)": s = |Δ1|, d = z; Δ1 = c_iid·ratings_iid − c_elo·(elo_overall + elo_surf_offset), each rescaled walk-forward. Secondary z × |N|; |Δ1| as context
controls_m2: M-set; Δ1, |Δ1| (originator's main effects); |Δ1|·η; Std
data_timing: Model frame only; safe
expected_effect: Negative (shrink the price); mismatches the statistics see as closer; +0.05 to +0.2 mLL
kill_test: Coefficient ≥ 0 or spans 0
deployment: TabPFN input and calibration slope modifier (framing item 3)
notes: Built from inputs already in the model. Named in I-030's merge condition. Δ1 is shared with I-080, I-081

title: Margin-aware de-vig
primary_column_m2: "shin_gap = logit p_S − z", p_S = π + (Q − 1)(π − ½); ≈ (Q − 1)·(π − ½)/(π(1 − π)): s = overround Q − 1, d = an odd, convex function of the price. Secondary m = Q − 1; power-method gap
controls_m2: M-set; m; m·η; Std
data_timing: stage1_odds avg, overround, coherence, 2010–2026; the match's own quotes, safe
expected_effect: Positive, near 1 if the additive rule is right; +0.03 to +0.2 mLL; heavy favourites, high-margin seasons, women
kill_test: Adds ≤ 0 beyond the best OOS forecast with m included, or spans 0; or fails to replicate in 2022–2024
deployment: TabPFN input and calibration slope modifier (framing item 3)
notes: Same modulator as withdrawn MAT-M4 (z × overround, killed by calculation: overround SD ≈ 0.5 pp), whose kept suggestion is a power or Shin de-vig as the odds input. MKT-01's function of the price differs (convex, not linear)

title: Obscure-match slope: FLB by level, round and fame
primary_column_m2: "z × O", O = max(log rank_A, log rank_B) − the tour median: s = O, d = z. Secondary z × S250, z × R
controls_m2: M-set; O; O·η; Std
data_timing: Model frame level and round; Stage 0 rank (unranked rule plus a flag); safe
expected_effect: Positive (favourites under-priced in obscure matches); +0.05 to +0.15 mLL
kill_test: Spans 0 in discovery; or vanishes once I-035's m and shin_gap are in
deployment: TabPFN input and calibration slope modifier
notes: Rank is not among the 58 inputs. Cluster I-080 (attention uses −min log rank), I-084 (prominence ΣT × price)

title: Book dispersion as uncertainty
primary_column_m2: "z × a", a = 1 − (1/max_A + 1/max_B), the arbitrage margin: s = a, d = z. Secondary N × a, Δ1 × a; spread d as context
controls_m2: M-set; a; a·η; Std
data_timing: stage1_odds max and avg, 2010–2026; outlier and incoherence rules; safe
expected_effect: Negative on z × a, positive on N × a; +0.1 to +0.3 mLL
kill_test: Both columns span 0 in discovery; [A] if it vanishes with the Pinnacle anchor
deployment: TabPFN input and calibration slope modifier; needs bookmaker quotes at bet time
notes: Motivating prior was post hoc (≈ 60 cells, seen on 2022+). Unknown whether OddsPortal's Max includes exchange prices. Cluster I-038

title: Best-price skew: steam or shading, told apart by fame
primary_column_m2: Two columns, one hypothesis: "k × (1 − fam) and k × fam", k = logit p_max(A) − z (d), fam = 1[sign(k) = −sign(ΔF)] (s). Secondary Bet365 shading × fam
controls_m2: k; ΔF; M-set; Std
data_timing: stage1_odds max, avg, b365, 2010–2026; fame from Stage 0; safe
expected_effect: Opposite signs: negative on k(1 − fam), positive on k·fam; +0.05 to +0.2 mLL
kill_test: Both span 0, or both take the same sign
notes: Uses I-083's fame F. A two-coefficient contrast, not a single column

title: Sharp–soft split (diagnostic)
primary_column_m2: "N × α against N × (1 − α)", α = 1[sign(s) = sign(N)], s = logit p_PS − z: s-mod = α, d = N (profile nudge index). Secondary s
controls_m2: N, s; M-set; Std
data_timing: stage1_odds Pinnacle, 2010 to mid-January 2026 (and the men's 2018 workbook if linked); safe
expected_effect: Diagnostic; as a feature s is worth at most the ≈ 0.7 mLL average–Pinnacle gap
kill_test: As a feature: equal coefficients and s adds nothing; the split is reported regardless
notes: Not a 2026 feature: Pinnacle stops in January 2026. Originator: run regardless

title: Context-dependent recalibration of the adjustment
primary_column_m2: "z_final = a·z_mkt + (b0 + b1·c)(z_model − z_mkt)": s = c (one to three symmetric contexts: evidence r̄, adjustment size, format), d = the model's adjustment
controls_m2: M-set; the adjustment (b0 term); Std
data_timing: The current best's walk-forward OOS forecasts from 2014, with contexts
expected_effect: Plausibly 0.1–0.3 mLL; each parameter costs ≈ 0.05
kill_test: Prequential 2019–2021: b1's CI includes 0 for every c, or gain < +0.05 → kill
notes: The set of contexts is open ("one to three"). One context, adjustment size, is a function of d itself. Uses I-032's r̄. Cluster I-041; the critique's S1 nudge layer

title: Non-linear shrinkage of the adjustment
primary_column_m2: "z_final = z_mkt + g(z_model − z_mkt)", g odd (b1·a + b3·a³, or a soft threshold): the cubic is s × d with s = a², d = a
controls_m2: a (linear); M-set; Std
data_timing: As I-040
expected_effect: Unknown; 0–0.2 mLL
kill_test: Prequential 2019–2021: b3's CI includes 0 → kill
notes: Prior: the meta-stack's signed square tied (in a no-odds stack). The screen's own nuisance cubic is in η, not in the adjustment

title: Retirement hazard × price (settlement and fragility)
primary_column_m2: τ = h_B/p − h_A/(1 − p). MAT "τ_hz = ĥ_B/p_mkt − ĥ_A/(1 − p_mkt)"; MKT "c/(π(1 − π))", c = h_B(1 − π) − h_A·π; BOD "z = h_B/p − h_A/(1 − p)". M2: τ = −½·Δh/(p(1−p)) + ½·Σh·(1 − 2p)/(p(1−p)): an S-term (s = 1/(p(1−p)), d = Δh) plus Σh × an odd function of the price (compression)
controls_m2: Δh; M-set; (1/(p(1−p)))·η; Σh·η; Std
data_timing: stage0 status (retired, walkover) on earlier matches at all levels; own history safe. Variant (c) pools other players' finished seasons, walk-forward by season
expected_effect: MAT: bound 0.05 / 0.18 / 0.73 mLL (men) at σ_h = 0.5 / 1 / 2 pp; lowers fragile favourites. MKT: coefficient 0.2–1; +0.05 to +0.3. BOD: negative for the high-hazard player, mostly as favourite; Slams, heat; 0.05–0.3
kill_test: MAT: precheck, de-noised SD of a persistent per-player rate < 0.5 pp → kill; then < +0.1 mLL. MKT: ≤ 0 or spans 0; check the books' retirement rules. BOD: (a) hazard model no better than the base rate out of sample; (b) nothing beyond the forecast; (c) no larger gain when the high-hazard player is the favourite
notes: Hazard estimators kept as nested variants: (a) MKT-20, shrunk 24-month rate; (b) MAT-W2, shrunk retirement and walkover rate with recent-retirement and layoff modifiers; (c) BOD-12, walk-forward logistic model (recent retirement or walkover, 52-week rate, age, Fat, load ratio, layoff, best of, month). Settlement rules unverified in all three. MKT's secondary "1[retired in the last 30 days]" is written per player (presumably a difference). Cluster I-043, I-044, I-052, I-057

title: Rust after an unplanned layoff × age × how it began
primary_column_m2: "Rust_X = U_X·exp(−n_X/ν)·(1 + ρ·(age_X − 28)+ + η·1[pre-gap retirement or walkover given] + ψ·1[entry PR or SR])", diff Rust_A − Rust_B (U = excess gap over its calendar expectation)
controls_m2: W: ΔU, Δage; surf_layoff pairs; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 at every level, entry codes; safe. E[gap] frozen on 2010–2018
expected_effect: Negative for the returner, larger with age and an injury start, fading over 1–3 matches; 0.02–0.15 mLL
kill_test: No gain; or no decay with matches since the return
notes: Near-duplicate of I-044 (different formula: graded gap with decay and age here; indicators × pre-break Elo there). Low prevalence

title: Returning from injury: reputation against rust
primary_column_m2: "Δ(inj × 1[L ≥ 56] × 1[m ≤ 2] × e_pre)", e_pre = Elo before the break − tour mean. Secondary: the same without e_pre
controls_m2: The term without e_pre; Δe_pre; surf_layoff; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 status, entry, dates; Elo; safe
expected_effect: Negative; ≈ 1–2% of matches; +0.02 to +0.1 mLL
kill_test: ≥ 0 or spans 0; or the same for non-injury breaks (then rust, already tested)
notes: Prior: the frontier's absence × Elo tied. Near-duplicate of I-043

title: Within-event serve decay: a fatigue or injury sensor
primary_column_m2: "Tr_X = the shrunk slope of X's first_won and first_in residuals against X's profile" over this event and the previous one; diff Tr_A − Tr_B, and its product with Fat. Speed variant: last two matches' first-serve speed − 52-week mean
controls_m2: W: form_first_won, form_first_in; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 box scores (safe); serve speeds from Slam and point feeds (partial, mostly from 2019)
expected_effect: Negative; small; noisy
kill_test: Split-half reliability of Tr not above the pure-luck replay's; then the screen
notes: The speed variant is close to I-020's speed change (last 5 matches there), without the returner cross. Product with Fat uses I-052

title: Early in a surface season, return-heavy profiles are stalest
primary_column_m2: "g_P = q_P·[(D^spw_P − D̄_c) − (O^spw_P − Ō_c)]", x = g_A − g_B; within-player product = ½[Δq·Σshape + Σq·Δshape]
controls_m2: W: Δshape (existing ΔO^spw, ΔD^spw), surf_season pairs; Σq·η, Σshape·η; Std
data_timing: Model frame and surface IOS; leak-proof
expected_effect: Small. Prior: the surface study's early-season subgroup did not replicate (+0.42 then +0.05, a tie)
kill_test: Screen gain < 0.05 mLL in early-season matches
notes: q is called a "flag" from surf_season_a/b, which is a count (threshold not stated). Near-duplicate of I-047 (graded switch state, other style measure, opposite sign convention). Early-season subgroup (critique S8)

title: Surface-switch adaptation by style and by age
primary_column_m2: Two columns, no primary declared: "New_A·Sty_A − New_B·Sty_B" and "New_A·(age_A − 28) − New_B·(age_B − 28)", New = exp(−n_surf_season/ν)·log(1 + surf_layoff/30)
controls_m2: W: ΔSty, Δage; surf_season, surf_layoff pairs; ΣNew·η, ΣSty·η, Σage·η; Std
data_timing: Model frame pairs; Stage 3 ratings; per-player surface IOS (leak-proof)
expected_effect: Grass: New × serve style positive; clay: New × return style positive; switch weeks; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: No interaction beyond the pairs and the forecast in switch weeks
notes: The sign is stated by surface, which implies a surface × New × Sty term. Age arm: cluster family 13

title: A stale surface profile: reliability by surface layoff
primary_column_m2: "ios*_X,s = w_X·ios_X,s(surface) + (1 − w_X)·ios_X,s(all surfaces)", w = n/(n + k)·exp(−surf_layoff/θ); diffs Δios*_s. New part: Δ[(1 − w)·dev], dev = surface − all-surface rating, = ½[Δ(1 − w)·Σdev + Σ(1 − w)·Δdev]
controls_m2: U: the unweighted Δios (existing iosO, iosD); Δ all-surface IOS; Std
data_timing: Per-player surface and all-surface IOS (surface_features, leak-proof); surf_layoff
expected_effect: Small but broad; opening weeks of grass and clay; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: The reweighted profile ties the plain one
deployment: diff columns beside or instead of iosO / iosD
notes: Its weight n/(n + k) is I-032's r. The surface − all-surface deviation may overlap the surface study's deviation columns, which the critique proposes as known-null placebos (P3): auditors to check

title: Early-surface-season under-confidence of the price
primary_column_m2: "z × E", E = 1[min(n_A, n_B) < 3] (matches on this surface this season): s = E, d = z. Secondary z × E × 1[hard], z × E × 1[grass]; graded E′ = exp(−min(n_A, n_B)/3)
controls_m2: M-set; E; E·η; Std
data_timing: Model frame surf_season_a/b, surface, odds_logit; safe
expected_effect: Positive (steepen early); Australian summer, grass openers; +0.05 to +0.2 mLL
kill_test: Spans 0 or ≤ 0 beyond the best OOS forecast; or no replication in 2022–2024; [A] if it vanishes with Pinnacle
deployment: TabPFN input and calibration slope modifier
notes: The surf_season scale is inferred (log(1 + n), to confirm). Motivating slopes were fitted on 2013–2025 and 2019–2026. Same early-season state as I-046, I-047, different d

title: Indoor/outdoor switch × serve style
primary_column_m2: "In_A·Sty_A − In_B·Sty_B", In = 1[previous match outdoor and this indoor, or the reverse]·exp(−n_recent indoor/ν)
controls_m2: W: ΔSty, ΔIn; ΣIn·η, ΣSty·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 indoor (men); women's indoor missing on every row (tennis-data's Court field may supply it); safe
expected_effect: Small; the autumn; 0.02–0.1 mLL
kill_test: No gain
notes: Women's coverage gap. Same form as I-047 for indoor; cluster I-073

title: Load split: on-site survival against carried-over debt
primary_column_m2: Three d columns: On_A − On_B (log(1 + on-site matches)), Ex_A − Ex_B (on-site minutes beyond their expectation), Off_A − Off_B (decayed off-site minutes, τ ∈ {3, 7} days)
controls_m2: W: sets_14d (the sum they split); Std
data_timing: Stage 0 matches and players at every level; clock obs; own matches, safe. Expectation frozen on 2010–2018
expected_effect: Off and Ex negative; On small and positive once they are held; first match of an event (43% of player-matches); 0.1–0.4 mLL
kill_test: The three add nothing beyond the price and the forecast; or equal coefficients (the split adds nothing)
notes: A three-column test. On is close to I-076's r and I-075's OS. Registered as frontier A07

title: Duration × recency: a fitness–fatigue kernel on the match clock
primary_column_m2: d columns: Fat_A − Fat_B, Fat = log(1 + Σ_j L_j·exp(−Δ_j/τ2)), τ2 ∈ {1.5, 3, 5} days; Fit_A − Fit_B, τ1 ∈ {21, 42}
controls_m2: W: sets_14d; surf_layoff pairs; Std
data_timing: As I-051; rest in hours would need start times (Australian Open archive; Slam feeds from 2019)
expected_effect: Fat negative, Fit positive; where rest is short and unequal (30% men, 23% women of matches with both active); 0.1–0.5 mLL
kill_test: For every τ2 in the grid, Fat adds nothing beyond sets_14d, the price and the forecast
notes: τ "tuned on 2013–2018": the tuning target is not stated (the critique's M5 asks for targets free of the price and the current best). The 12-day Masters from 2023 changes rest in replication

title: Age × recovery debt
primary_column_m2: "Debt_X = Fat_X(τ2(age_X))"; simpler "Fat_X·(age_X − 26)+": Δ[Fat·a] = ½[ΔFat·Σa + ΣFat·Δa], a = (age − 26)+. Variant × (1 + γ·1[best_of = 5])
controls_m2: W: ΔFat, age, age_sq, sets_14d; ΣFat·η, Σa·η; variant: 1[bo5]·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 age (97.5%) and loads; safe
expected_effect: Negative for older, recently loaded players; men; Slams' second weeks, back-to-back weeks; 0.05–0.3 mLL
kill_test: Nothing beyond the Fat and age differences and the forecast; or the age gradient flips between 2013–2018 and 2019–2021
notes: The brief's own example. Cluster I-066 (E_min·Δage, Δsets), I-024, family 13

title: Both tired against one tired
primary_column_m2: "z1 = (Fat_A + Fat_B − c)·odds_logit": s = ΣFat − c, d = ℓ. Also "z2 = (Fat_A − Fat_B)/(Fat_A + Fat_B + c)" and the pair (Fat_A, Fat_B)
controls_m2: z1: M-set; ΣFat·η; ΔFat; Std
data_timing: As I-052
expected_effect: z1 negative (the price over-confident when both are tired), low confidence; men's Slam second weeks, women's consecutive weeks; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: z1 adds nothing, and the price's slope does not differ between the top and bottom quintiles of ΣFat
deployment: z1, z2 diff columns; the pair
notes: Same price × sum form as family 06, with a load sum

title: The favourite's hidden fatigue
primary_column_m2: "z1 = s·max(u, 0)" and "z2 = −s·max(−u, 0)", s = sign(odds_logit), u = s·ΔFat; z1 + z2 = ΔFat. The asymmetry is z1 − z2 = sign(ℓ)·|ΔFat|: s-mod = |ΔFat|, d = sign(ℓ)
controls_m2: ΔFat (main); M-set; |ΔFat|·η; Std
data_timing: Fat (I-052) and the price
expected_effect: β1 more negative than β2; heavier favourites; 0.05–0.15 mLL
kill_test: β1 = β2 within error
notes: The tested contrast is a step function of the price (sign at ℓ = 0)

title: Previous-round scare × rest
primary_column_m2: Two d columns: "Scare_A·1[rest_A ≤ 1] − Scare_B·1[rest_B ≤ 1]" and "Scare_A·1[rest_A ≥ 2] − Scare_B·1[rest_B ≥ 2]"; the hypothesis is their contrast, Δ[Scare·(1[rest ≤ 1] − 1[rest ≥ 2])]
controls_m2: ΔScare; Δrest; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 scores, statuses, the clock; safe. 4,085 men's and 4,318 women's matches with exactly one such player
expected_effect: Negative with ≤ 1 day of rest, positive with ≥ 2; both tours; 0.05–0.3 mLL
kill_test: The two coefficients do not differ (same sign, or both span 0)
notes: Three Scare definitions offered (deciding set; closeness; points below expectation). No price term although typed M. Cluster I-086, I-025

title: Acute-to-chronic load spike
primary_column_m2: "R_X = (L7_X + c)/(L28_X/4 + c)", diff f(R_A) − f(R_B) with f = log R or (R − 1.5)+; an age-product variant
controls_m2: W: the L7 and L28 differences, or Fat and Fit (I-052); sets_14d; Std
data_timing: As I-052; 28-day minutes complete for 86% (men) and 55% (women) of player-matches
expected_effect: Negative above about 1.5; both tours; 0.05–0.15 mLL
kill_test: Nothing beyond Fit and Fat
notes: Two forms of f offered. Also an input of I-042 variant (c)

title: Recovery as a player trait
primary_column_m2: "Trait_A·Fat_A − Trait_B·Fat_B" = ½[ΔTrait·ΣFat + ΣTrait·ΔFat]; Trait = shrunk points above expectation in high-Fat minus low-Fat matches
controls_m2: W: ΔFat, ΔTrait; ΣFat·η, ΣTrait·η; Std; slow trait (M4 factor)
data_timing: Stage 0 box scores; Stage 3 expectations; safe; shrinkage by Stage 3's method on 2010–2018
expected_effect: Small; the prior is failure (no late-decline trait in Stage C)
kill_test: Split-half reliability not above Stage C's pure-luck replay, checked before any outcome screen

title: Last week's deep run × a short gap × travel
primary_column_m2: "Run_X = (matches won at X's previous event, or 1[SF or F]) × exp(−gap_X/τ) × (1 + μ·Trav_X)", τ ∈ {2, 4}; diff Run_A − Run_B
controls_m2: W: the component differences; sets_14d; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 rounds and ids; the clock; event-country table plus a continent map; safe
expected_effect: Negative in the first match of the new event; larger with travel and a shorter gap; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: No gain; or no dose–response with the gap
notes: Near-duplicate of I-088 (title or final within 9 days × first match, indicators): different formula. Cluster I-074

title: Consecutive weeks away × age
controls_m2: W: ΔWk, Δage, ΔAway; Fit, Fat (I-052); Std
data_timing: Stage 0 country; event-country table; a continent map (to build); safe
expected_effect: Negative from about the fourth week, more for older players; the Asian and American swings; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: Nothing beyond Fit and Fat; or no monotone rise with weeks

title: Season odometer × age × time of year
primary_column_m2: "[Odo_X·(age_X − 27)+·1[month ≥ 9]]_A − [·]_B": s = 1[month ≥ 9] (context), d = Δ[Odo·(age − 27)+]. Off-season variant "[log(off-season days)·(age_X − 27)]_A − [·]_B"
controls_m2: S: d, s·η; W: ΔOdo, Δage; Std
data_timing: Stage 0; expectation by date and ranking band frozen on 2010–2018; safe
expected_effect: Negative for overloaded veterans in September–November; men; 0.02–0.1 mLL
kill_test: No gain; or not concentrated in the autumn
notes: Uses ranking bands (rank is not an input)

title: Off-tour load: team ties and their travel
primary_column_m2: "Team_X = log(1 + Σ_{team ties, Δ_j ≤ 21} L_j·exp(−Δ_j/τ))·(1 + Trav_X)"; diff
controls_m2: W: sets_14d; I-051 and I-052 built with team ties; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 level TEAM (8,551 matches to 2024; 34% undated, median window 8 days); safe
expected_effect: Negative; September and February; 0.02–0.1 mLL
kill_test: Nothing beyond I-051 and I-052 built with team ties included
notes: Whether sets_14d already counts team ties: cartographer

family: Fatigue crossed with style and the point model (attrition)
title: Fatigue composed through the point model
primary_column_m2: "Δ = logit P_iid(p_A − δ_A + η·δ_B, p_B − δ_B + η·δ_A; format, deciding-set rule) − logit P_iid(p_A, p_B; …)", δ_X = κ·Fat_X (+ λ per 100 points). First order: s = the iid leverage at the pair's dominance and format, d ∝ ΔFat
controls_m2: C: the plain ΔFat; s·η; best_of·ΔFat; Std
data_timing: stage3_ratings p_serve_a/b; stage2_iid; Fat; safe. κ, η, λ tuned on 2013–2018
expected_effect: Negative for the more tired player; 1.25–2 times larger at Bo5; men's Slams; 0.1–0.3 mLL
kill_test: Nothing beyond the plain Fat difference; or the Bo5 slope not larger than Bo3
notes: Tuning target for κ, η, λ not stated. Cluster I-006, I-001. Bo5 subgroup (critique S8)

family: Fatigue crossed with style and the point model (attrition)
title: Own style × own fatigue
primary_column_m2: "Fat_A·Sty_A − Fat_B·Sty_B" = ½[ΔFat·ΣSty + ΣFat·ΔSty]. Variant: shift each profile statistic with Fat, then recompute prod_* and the point model
controls_m2: W: ΔFat, ΔSty; ΣFat·η, ΣSty·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 3 ratings (safe); per-player IOS (surface_features, leak-proof)
expected_effect: The sign is the hypothesis (two-sided); tired players with extreme styles; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: The fatigue slope does not differ across style terciles
notes: Sign undeclared. Same Sty as I-047, I-050

family: Fatigue crossed with style and the point model (attrition)
title: The opponent who exploits fatigue
primary_column_m2: Two columns: "X1 = R_A·Fat_B − R_B·Fat_A" = ½[ΔR·ΣFat − ΣR·ΔFat] (R = opponent-adjusted seconds per point); "X2 = Ret2_A·Fat_B − Ret2_B·Fat_A" (second-serve return strength)
controls_m2: X: ΔR (ΔRet2), ΔFat; ΣR·η, ΣFat·η; prod_second_won for X2; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 minutes and tpw_d (women: minutes from 2016, box-score holes before 2019); IOS-based Ret2 needs leak-proof IOS
expected_effect: Positive for the grinder or returner facing a tired opponent; clay; Bo5; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: X1 and X2 add nothing beyond their main effects; or seconds per point has split-half reliability < 0.3
notes: No primary declared. Cluster I-066 (pace), I-067

family: Fatigue crossed with style and the point model (attrition)
title: Rally pace × load and age: attrition exposure in minutes
primary_column_m2: "E_min·Δsets_14d and E_min·Δage": s = E_min = E_points(the price's closeness, format) × (mpp_A + mpp_B)/2, d = Δsets_14d or Δage
controls_m2: S: d, s·η; M-set (s depends on the price's closeness); Std
data_timing: stage0 minutes (men 91%, women 70%, sparse before 2016); own-order (safe)
expected_effect: Small. Prior: fatigue × expected length showed no sign given Elo (UFC-ideas Stage C)
kill_test: Screen gain < 0.05 mLL
notes: No primary declared. Cluster I-053, I-065

family: Fatigue crossed with style and the point model (attrition)
title: Heat × age × load × style
primary_column_m2: "Heat_m × [Fat_X·(1 + ρ·(age_X − 28)+)·(1 + ψ·R_X)]_A − [·]_B": s = Heat_m (context), d = Δ[within-player product]
controls_m2: S: d, s·η; W: ΔFat, Δage, ΔR; Std
data_timing: None on disk: venue coordinates and a weather archive are needed (climate normals a weak proxy)
expected_effect: Negative for old, tired grinders in heat; Australian Open, US summer, Miami, Shanghai; size unknown
kill_test: Park it if the data are unavailable; otherwise no gain
notes: Data not held. Cluster family 14

title: Age reshapes the profile: return and rally decay first
primary_column_m2: "g_P = (age_P − 28)·[(D^spw_P − D̄_c) − (O^spw_P − Ō_c)]", x = g_A − g_B = ½[Δa·Σshape + Σa·Δshape]; hinge variant (age − 29)+
controls_m2: W: age, age_sq, Δshape (existing ΔO^spw, ΔD^spw); Σa·η, Σshape·η; Std
data_timing: stage0 age; surface IOS; leak-proof
expected_effect: Negative; men mainly; 0.05–0.15 mLL
kill_test: Outcome-free first: after 29, the return residual must drift more negative than the serve residual; then the screen
notes: Originator: it corrects the model, not the price. Near-duplicate of I-069 (different formula)

title: Style-specific ageing: servers age more slowly
primary_column_m2: "Drift_X = (age_X − 29)+·(RetShare_X − 0.5)·M_X" (M = the profile's effective memory); diff. Variant: per-statistic drifts
controls_m2: W: Δage, ΔRetShare, ΔM; Std
data_timing: Stage 3 ratings, per-player IOS (leak-proof), ages; a statistics-only check on 2010–2018 box scores
expected_effect: Negative for older return-based players; men; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: The statistics-only check shows no style difference in the age curves; or the product adds nothing
notes: A three-way within-player product. Near-duplicate of I-068

title: Age-dependent trust in recent form
primary_column_m2: "Mix_X = (Short_X − Long_X)·h(age_X)", h(age) = (25 − age)+ − κ·(age − 30)+; diff = ½[Δ(S − L)·Σh + Σ(S − L)·Δh]
controls_m2: W: Δ(Short − Long) (existing form and IOS differences), Δage; Σh·η, Σ(S − L)·η; Std
data_timing: Per-player short and long profiles (leak-proof IOS); ages
expected_effect: Positive weight on recent-minus-long for the young; women (37% aged ≤ 23) and young men; 0.1–0.3 mLL
kill_test: The product adds nothing beyond its main effects
notes: Number of columns not fixed. Same (recent − long) as I-031, weighted by age instead of reliability

title: Rank anchoring × career trajectory
primary_column_m2: "Δ(g × a)", g = ê(log rank) − Elo (ranked better than rated), a = (age − 27)/5: ½[Δg·Σa + Σg·Δa]. Secondary Δg; Δ(T × 1[age ≤ 23]); Δ(T × 1[age ≥ 30])
controls_m2: W: Δg, ΔT, Δage (in model); Σg·η, Σa·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 rank (tournament start) and age; Elo history; safe; ê fitted on earlier seasons
expected_effect: Δg negative; Δ(g × a) negative; trajectory terms positive; women more; 0.1–0.4 mLL
kill_test: The primary and Δg both span 0 in discovery; [A] if it vanishes with Pinnacle
notes: Motivated by "age is the strongest nudge given the price" (market anchoring, 2013–2025). Rank is not an input. Cluster family 15, I-083

title: Leak-proof venue pace × each player's serve/return shape
primary_column_m2: "v_e·ΔO^ace and v_e·ΔD^spw": s = v_e (shrunk, decayed ace residual of earlier editions, plus the current edition's earlier days), d = ΔO^ace, ΔD^spw; v_e also as context
controls_m2: S: d, s·η; Std
data_timing: stage0 box scores and tournament ids (venue key checks); surface IOS expectations; field (clock, probe)
expected_effect: Positive on v·ΔO^ace; men, hard, indoor, altitude; ≤ 0.1 mLL. Prior: a thinner proxy tied (+0.07, given Pinnacle)
kill_test: (1) Outcome-free: v_e must forecast the edition's own residual at r ≥ 0.3; (2) the products add < 0.05 mLL
deployment: context column and two diff columns
notes: Two products, no single primary. Its serve-point analogue feeds I-001's m. Cluster I-012, I-077

title: Per-player indoor deviations in the profile
primary_column_m2: "x = I·[(G_A − H_B) − (G_B − H_A)] = I·(ΔG + ΔH)": s = I (indoor), d = ΔG + ΔH from an extended IOS
controls_m2: S: d, I·η; indoor; Std
data_timing: stage0 indoor flag; field (a new IOS term on the clock, probe)
expected_effect: Small. Prior: surface deviations were priced (+0.01, a tie)
kill_test: G and H carry over between split seasons at r < 0.15 → kill
notes: Women's indoor is missing on every Stage 0 row (observed in the body list), so women are not buildable from Stage 0. Cluster I-050

title: Jet lag: zones × days since the last match × direction
primary_column_m2: "JL_X = (a·(ΔZ_X)+ + b·(−ΔZ_X)+)·(1 − T_X/(c·abs(ΔZ_X)))+·(1 + ρ·(age_X − 28)+)"; diff JL_A − JL_B
controls_m2: W: the component differences; Std
data_timing: A city → UTC-offset table (not on disk; daylight saving, team-tie venues) and the clock; safe
expected_effect: Negative in the first one or two matches after ≥ 5 zones within ≤ 5 days; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: No gain on first matches with |ΔZ| ≥ 5 and T ≤ 5; no decay with T and no east–west asymmetry
notes: Table to build. Registered as frontier C03. Cluster I-059, I-078

title: On-site acclimatisation × how new the conditions are
primary_column_m2: "OS_A·Nov_A − OS_B·Nov_B" = ½[ΔOS·ΣNov + ΣOS·ΔNov]; OS = log(1 + on-site matches), Nov = surface switch + indoor switch + |ΔZ|/12 + altitude change (km)
controls_m2: W: ΔOS, ΔNov; ΣOS·η, ΣNov·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 (tournament_id, surface, men's indoor); tables of I-074, I-050, I-077; safe
expected_effect: Positive for the acclimatised player when conditions are new; 96-draw Masters, qualifiers after a continent change; 0.05–0.2 mLL
kill_test: OS·Nov adds nothing beyond OS and Nov
notes: OS is I-051's On. Registered as frontier C02. Cluster I-076

title: Event rhythm against a cold start
primary_column_m2: "X = r_A·c_B − r_B·c_A" = ½[Δr·Σc − Σr·Δc]; r = matches already played at this event (qualifying included), c = 1[first match here] × 1[previous match on another surface or > 10 days earlier]. Secondary 1[exactly one is Q or LL] × Δr
controls_m2: X: Δr, Δc; Σr·η, Σc·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 qualifying and entry codes (does qualifying link to its main draw: cartographer); the clock; safe
expected_effect: Positive; first and second rounds; +0.05 to +0.2 mLL
kill_test: ≤ 0 or spans 0
notes: r is I-051's On before the log; c is close to I-075's novelty for first matches

title: Altitude × serve profile × acclimatisation
primary_column_m2: S part: "Alt (km) × (iosO_ace_A − iosO_ace_B)": s = Alt, d = ΔiosO_ace. W part: Alt × ΔOS, or Alt × Δ(days on site)
controls_m2: S: d, s·η; Std
data_timing: An elevation table (about a dozen venues, not on disk); Stage 0
expected_effect: Positive for servers; a few mLL inside the subset, < 0.05 overall
kill_test: The within-subset gain spans 0; keep it only as a component of I-075's novelty
notes: Small subgroup (405 men's, 387 women's matches above ≈ 1,000 m; critique S8). Registered as frontier C04. Cluster I-072

title: Home split into crowd and no travel
primary_column_m2: Three columns, no primary: "(H_A − H_B)·g(level)" (s = g(level), d = ΔH); "[H_X·log rank_X]_A − [·]_B"; X-type "H_A·JL_B − H_B·JL_A" = ½[ΔH·ΣJL − ΣH·ΔJL]
controls_m2: ΔH (home's main effect); g(level)·η; ΔJL, ΣH·η, ΣJL·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 country; event-country table; JL from I-074 (table to build); safe
expected_effect: Small; 0.02–0.1 mLL. Stage 4 scored women's home as a main effect "worse" given Elo
kill_test: No gain beyond home's main effect
notes: g(level) is unspecified. Its first column may equal I-079's secondary if g = 1[not a Slam]. Cluster I-079

title: Home hype: home wildcards and home players at small events
primary_column_m2: "Δ(home × wc)" = ½[Δhome·Σwc + Σhome·Δwc]. Secondary "Δhome × (1 − 1[Slam])" (s = 1 − 1[Slam], d = Δhome)
controls_m2: Δhome, Δwc; Σhome·η, Σwc·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 country and entry; stage4_event_country.csv (Kingston blank; Monte Carlo coded Monaco); safe
expected_effect: Sign open; ≤ +0.1 mLL. Prior: home as a main effect added nothing given the market (Stage 4)
kill_test: Both columns span 0
notes: Two-sided. Cluster I-078

title: Attention-modulated disagreement
primary_column_m2: "Δ1 × (−A)": s = −A, the attention index (mean of standardised level, round depth, star power −min(log rank), crowding −log(1 + other matches that day)); d = Δ1. Secondary N × (−A); each component alone
controls_m2: S: Δ1, A, A·η; Std
data_timing: Model frame; Stage 0 rank and round; same-day scheduled counts (stage1_odds date or timing es); safe; N walk-forward
expected_effect: Positive; early rounds of 250s, obscure players, crowded days; +0.1 to +0.4 mLL
kill_test: Spans 0 in discovery, or the sign reverses in 2022–2024
notes: Originator notes TabPFN's largest gain at the Slams runs against it unless I-006 explains the Slams. Motivating Polymarket evidence is from 2025–2026. Cluster I-036, I-084, I-082

title: Profile weight by price level
primary_column_m2: "N × (1 − v)", v = 4π(1 − π): s = 1 − v (lopsidedness, a function of the price), d = N. Secondary Δ1 × (1 − v)
controls_m2: N, v; M-set; (1 − v)·η; Std
data_timing: Model frame; safe; N walk-forward
expected_effect: Sign open, leaning positive; +0.05 to +0.2 mLL
kill_test: Spans 0 in discovery
notes: Same form as withdrawn MAT-M6 (|z| × the model's adjustment, killed by calculation), with N in place of the adjustment and 1 − v in place of |z|

title: Salience-weighted evidence: form earned where nobody watches
primary_column_m2: "Δ(w̃_L × s_L)": s_L = opponent-adjusted points won above expectation in low-visibility matches (Challenger, WTA 125, qualifying), w̃ = w/(w + 200 points). Secondary Δ(w̃_H × s_H); the low-visibility share
controls_m2: W: the pooled two-week form (adjperf_tpw_2w, form_*); Std
data_timing: Stage 0 box scores by level (men's Challenger 99%; ITF none), levels, rounds; sequential adjustment safe, IOS-based needs the clock
expected_effect: β_L positive and β_L > β_H; men > women; players arriving from Challengers and qualifying; +0.1 to +0.5 mLL
kill_test: β_L ≤ 0 or spans 0, or β_L ≤ β_H
notes: Lower-level box scores more than double in 2025 (a shift between discovery and test, originator)

title: Fallen-star premium
primary_column_m2: "Δ(F × R)" = ½[ΔF·ΣR + ΣF·ΔR]; F = log(1 + titles + Slam QF or better), R = career-peak Elo − current Elo. Secondary ΔF; Δ(F × R) × (1 − v)
controls_m2: W: ΔF, ΔR; ΣF·η, ΣR·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 rounds and levels; Elo history; safe
expected_effect: Negative (fallen stars over-priced); men, ageing former top-10 players; +0.05 to +0.2 mLL
kill_test: ≥ 0 or spans 0
notes: F is reused by I-038. Cluster I-071

title: Pair prominence modulates how much the price knows
primary_column_m2: "z_mkt·(ΣT − mean ΣT) and Δprofile·(ΣT − mean ΣT)": s = ΣT (the pair's total strength, IOS spw O + D or offset-Elo levels), d = z_mkt and Δprofile
controls_m2: M-set; ΣT·η; Std
data_timing: surface_features; per-player Elo levels (cartographer to locate); leak-proof
expected_effect: 79κ² mLL (men), 68κ² (women): κ = 4% gives 0.13, 8% gives 0.50; a steeper price slope for prominent pairs
kill_test: Discovery 1-df slope interaction, CI includes 0 → kill
notes: Two terms; the sign is declared for the price term. Rank-based obscurity (I-036) and attention (I-080) are other measures of the same idea

title: Drifting favourite: over-reaction to news against the ratings favourite
primary_column_m2: "r × 1[sign(r) ≠ sign(F)]", r = z − F, F = a walk-forward price-free forecast: s = the sign-disagreement indicator, d = r
controls_m2: r; M-set; s·η; Std
data_timing: Model frame; walk-forward no-odds forecasts (rating race, meta-stack); safe if walk-forward
expected_effect: Negative (the drifted favourite is better than priced); +0.05 to +0.15 mLL
kill_test: Spans 0 or is positive
notes: Prior: the symmetric version tied (−0.03, meta stack, seen on 2022+). Information timing (news)

title: Last-round narrative: surprise wins and flattering scorelines
primary_column_m2: "Δs × 1[round ≥ QF]", s = 1 − p_prev (the surprise of the last win against its own price): s-mod = 1[round ≥ QF], d = Δs. Secondary Δs; Δλ (games share beyond the points won)
controls_m2: Δs; 1[round ≥ QF]·η; Std
data_timing: stage1_odds (previous match's odds); Stage 0 rounds, scores, games, box scores; safe
expected_effect: Negative (fade the narrative); +0.02 to +0.15 mLL
kill_test: Spans 0 or is positive
notes: Missing when the previous match had no price (flagged). Δλ is last-match conversion luck (I-025). Cluster I-056

title: Price-formation window
primary_column_m2: "N × 1[w ≤ 1]", w = min over players of (es − lf of the previous match), days: s = 1[w ≤ 1], d = N. Secondary Δ1 × 1[w ≤ 1]; z × 1[w ≤ 1]
controls_m2: N; 1[w ≤ 1]; s·η; Std
data_timing: timing.parquet es, lf (day resolution only); safe
expected_effect: Positive; later rounds of 250s and 500s, rain weeks; +0.02 to +0.1 mLL
kill_test: Spans 0
notes: Motivated by line-sharpening data from 2026. Information timing. Cluster I-052, I-056

title: Title last week: recency premium against a letdown
primary_column_m2: "Δ(τ × first)" = ½[Δτ·Σfirst + Στ·Δfirst]; τ = 1[title at an event whose final ended ≤ 9 days before es], first = 1[first match at this event]. Secondary Δ(φ × first) (lost final); Δ(τ × first × sw)
controls_m2: Δτ, Δfirst; Στ·η, Σfirst·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 rounds, events, surfaces, entry; timing; safe
expected_effect: Negative; ≈ 2–4% of matches; +0.05 to +0.2 mLL
kill_test: ≥ 0 or spans 0
notes: Near-duplicate of I-059 (graded by gap and travel there)

title: Calendar motivation
primary_column_m2: "Δ(top × pre) × 1[round ≥ QF]". pre is the same for both players (event-level), so this is s × d with s = pre·1[round ≥ QF], d = Δtop (top = 1[rank ≤ 20]). Secondary Δpost; Δdef
controls_m2: Δtop; s·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 calendar, rank, rank points; "def" needs a hand-made points table (cartographer); safe
expected_effect: Negative for pre and post, positive for def; +0.05 to +0.15 mLL
kill_test: All columns span 0
notes: Near-identical to I-090: the same d (Δ1[rank ≤ 20]); s differs (here QF and later at any pre-Slam event; there 250/500 events, all rounds). Small subgroup (critique S8)

title: Elite effort before Slams; incentive cliffs
primary_column_m2: "E_X = 1[rank_X ≤ 20]·1[level ∈ {250, 500}]·1[a Slam main draw starts within 8 days]", diff E_A − E_B = s × d with s = 1[250/500]·1[Slam within 8 days], d = Δ1[rank ≤ 20]. Variants: seeded at the coming Slam; points near cut-offs
controls_m2: Δtop; s·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 rank (tournament start), level, dates; safe. 305 men's and 592 women's 2013–2021 matches qualify
expected_effect: Negative for elite players in pre-Slam weeks; 0.02–0.15 mLL
kill_test: No gain; or no difference between pre-Slam and other weeks
notes: Near-identical to I-089 (see there). The cliff variant's thresholds are to be declared in advance (originator)

title: Public narrative statistics: head-to-head and venue records
primary_column_m2: "raw × 1[n ≥ 3]", raw = (wins_A − wins_B)/(n + 1), with the shrunk head-to-head Elo residual held: s = 1[n ≥ 3] (pair-level), d = raw. Secondary Δρ (venue win rate) with Δν held
controls_m2: raw; the Elo residual of meetings; 1[n ≥ 3]·η; Std
data_timing: Stage 0 meetings; tournament ids across seasons (continuity to check); Elo; safe
expected_effect: Negative raw coefficients; ≤ +0.1 mLL. Prior: men's head-to-head rows fell below their null band (Stage 4)
kill_test: Both columns span 0
notes: The originator's η (the head-to-head residual) is not the screen's η. Cluster I-019, I-025 arm (b)
